correctness.rationale: The 49 nonempty support pairs follow an explicit deterministic map on subsets of {0,1,2}. Its complete 7-by-7 distance/terminal-period table has only four recurrent support states in three components. For each recurrent support the full labelled configuration is immediately periodic with least period 1,3,or4, so support-entry time equals full-state-entry time. Exact onto-color counts give every joint time/period coefficient for all positive shore sizes; independent direct enumeration verified 63,972 configurations and a separate support routine checked 900 parameter pairs. No inferential step relies on a finite parameter cutoff.

value.rationale: The ten-class first-entry law is a natural, all-parameter, complete transient classification on a canonical family of excitable networks. It resolves quantities not reconstructible from the recurrent orbit census, proves that all fourth-step arrivals are extinct and gives each transient cohort eventually entering four-cycles. Its use as an intact-graph baseline for changes in network connectivity is precise and motivated, not a parameter-only increment.
